subject: operating-systems
title: Page-table translation simulation
summary: A page table maps virtual page numbers to physical frames while preserving the page offset and enforcing permissions.

questions.prompt: With 4 KiB pages, how many bits are in the page offset?
questions.answerKey: 4 KiB is 2^12 bytes, so the offset has 12 bits.
questions.explanation: The remaining virtual-address bits form the virtual page number.

questions.prompt: When translating a virtual address, which part is unchanged by paging?
questions.answerKey: The offset within a page is copied into the physical address.
questions.explanation: The virtual page number is replaced by a physical frame number.

questions.prompt: A 1 KiB page maps virtual page 3 to frame 7. What physical address corresponds to virtual address 3,250?
questions.answerKey: 3,250 = 3×1,024 + 178; frame 7 starts at 7,168, so the physical address is 7,346.

questions.prompt: What should a page-table entry contain to reject access to an unmapped page?
options: A valid/present bit set to not-present
questions.answerKey: A not-present/invalid entry causes a page fault or access failure rather than a valid translation.
questions.explanation: Permission bits additionally control read/write/execute access.

questions.prompt: Translate virtual address 0x2345 with 4 KiB pages when virtual page 2 maps to frame 9.
questions.answerKey: With 4 KiB pages, the offset is the low 12 bits: 0x345 (837). The virtual page is 0x2, so the physical address is 9×0x1000 + 0x345 = 0x9345.
questions.explanation: The offset remains 0x345; only the page number changes to the frame number.

questions.prompt: Explain what a TLB changes and what it does not change during address translation.
questions.answerKey: A TLB caches recent virtual-page-to-frame translations and can avoid a page-table memory walk on a hit. It does not change the logical mapping rules, page offset, protection checks, or the need to handle a miss/page fault.
questions.explanation: A TLB miss is not necessarily a page fault; the page-table entry may still be present.
